Growing up in Morocco there was always pressure to follow certain rules. People back home often expect the same path. The same choices. The same way of living. When I came to America I started making my own decisions. Some things from before no longer fit the life I want. I respect where I come from. But I also know what feels right for me now. You can keep your roots and still choose freedom. #moroccan #🇲🇦 #arab #culture #explore #moroccangirl

Growing up in Morocco, there was always this idea of how a woman should act in public. You learn to hold back. To stay proper. To not draw too much attention. Here in America it feels different. I can just be in the moment. Without measuring every move against what others might think. It is not about losing respect for yourself. It is about not letting other people’s expectations control every little thing. Freedom shows up in these small choices. Not having to worry if something looks wrong to someone else. #moroccan #🇲🇦 #arab #moroccangirl #dontjudge #explore

Would you wander Marrakech alone?  One thing I was honestly nervous about before coming to Marrakech for the first time was safety, especially as a woman travelling alone. Social media can make the medina look super intimidating, chaotic, and overwhelming, but my experience has actually been really positive. Of course you need to stay aware like in any big city, but I’ve spent hours wandering the souks, getting lost in little alleyways, shopping, stopping for mint tea, and exploring on my own and I genuinely felt okay. One thing that helped SO much this time was not carrying all my luggage around with me 😅 dragging a huge backpack through crowded streets instantly makes you feel more stressed and overwhelmed. I used @bounce luggage storage so I could explore Marrakech freely for the day before my riad check-in, and it made such a difference. I could actually enjoy the medina instead of worrying about my bags the entire time. Bounce has thousands of locations worldwide and is a super reliable resource if you find yourself in a similar situation as me. If you’re travelling soon, you can use my code SARAHBOUNCE for a discount! #travelhacks #travelreccommendations #solotraveller

Some people think because you deliver food you have to go along with anything. They see the job first. They forget there is a person behind it. Back home in Morocco respect comes before any request. You do not cross lines just because you can pay for something. Here it can feel different. Some act like the uniform means they get to decide the rules. My work does not erase my limits. It does not change what feels wrong. And it does not give anyone the right to treat me like less than a person. #moroccan #🇲🇦 #arab #moroccangirl #explore #dontjudge
